paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Nazir, chapter 9, halakhah 4; R' Yose reported in his name.[^1]

notes.text: The source explicitly gives Jerusalem Talmud Nazir chapter 9 halakhah 4, without independent named-edition verification. Earlier machine פ״מ differs from supplied פ״ט. Yose reports Meyasha, without identifying which Yose. Both personal titles remain R'; catalog רבי is not transferred into the supplied abbreviated heading.
